settings.title: Settings
settings.useBigCharsMcap: Use big characters for market cap
settings.satsVariantHelp: Pick which of the 16 sats glyphs the device draws on the price screens.
settings.digitFontPxHelp: Pixel height of the big digits on data screens. Default 180. Lower = more whitespace; higher = fills the panel.
settings.wifiRebootMin: Reboot if WiFi down for (minutes, 0 = never)
settings.requiresSuffixPrice: Requires Suffix price format to be enabled
settings.shortAmountsWarning: Short amounts might shorten lifespan of the displays
settings.tzOffsetHelpText: A restart is required to apply TZ offset.
settings.dragToReorder: Drag rows or use the arrows to change rotation order
settings.wifiTxPowerText: In most cases this does not need to be set.
settings.remoteDriftWarning: Settings have changed on the device since you loaded the page. Reload to see the latest values.
settings.pendingRebootWarning: Some saved changes only take effect after a reboot.
settings.mempoolInstanceHelpText: Only effective when BTClock data-source is disabled. A restart is required to apply.
settings.miningPoolUser: Mining Pool username or api key
settings.nostrZapPubkeysHint: Add up to 8 recipient pubkeys (hex or npub). All zaps to any of these get notified.
settings.nostrRelaysHint: Add up to 4 relay URLs (wss://). Reboots take effect on save.
settings.nostrRelayRequired: At least one Nostr relay is required
settings.invalidNostrPubkey: Invalid Nostr pubkey, note that your pubkey does NOT start with npub.
settings.invalidNostrRelay: Invalid Nostr relay, URL must start with wss://
settings.otaPassHelp: Leave blank to allow password-less OTA.
settings.passwordSetLeaveBlank: Password is set. Leave blank to keep unchanged.
settings.useNostrTooltip: Very experimental and unstable. Nostr data source is not required for Nostr Zap notifications.
settings.proxyBypassHelp: Comma-separated host globs that connect directly. Supports exact, *.suffix and prefix.* patterns.
settings.proxyAuthIgnoredHelp: SOCKS4/4a have no auth — credentials are ignored for those types.
settings.proxyReconnectToast: Proxy updated — open WebSocket sessions will reconnect.
settings.flOffOnDnd: Frontlight off during Do Not Disturb
settings.timeBasedDnd: Enable Do Not Disturb time schedule
settings.screenRestoreZap: Restore previous screen state after zap (Uses {setting} setting)
settings.refrScrnChange: Full refresh on each screen change
settings.thirdPartyExtrasWarning: The third-party data source (mempool.space/Kraken) is very data-intensive; enabling Bitaxe, mining pool stats or Nostr zaps alongside it may freeze the device. Prefer the BTClock source or a custom endpoint — if you still want extras, don't enable them all at once.

control.title: Control
control.fwTooOld: Firmware too old for this WebUI. Required: {min}, running: {current}. Some features may misbehave until you update.

status.title: Status
status.fetchEuroNote: If you use "Fetch € price" the WS Price connection will show ❌  since it uses another data source.

firmwareUpdater.fileUploadFailed: File upload failed. Make sure you have selected the correct file and try again.
firmwareUpdater.fileUploadSuccess: File uploaded successfully, restarting device and reloading WebUI in {countdown} seconds
firmwareUpdater.firmwareUpdateText: When you use the firmware upload functionality, make sure you use the correct files. Uploading the wrong files can result in a non-working device. If it goes wrong, you can restore firmware by uploading the full image after setting the device in BOOT-mode.

rssiBar.tooltip: Values > -67 dBm are considered good. > -30 dBm is amazing
